statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is true if and only if there exist an integer k >= 0 and arrays A^0,...,A^k, each of length n, such that: (1) A^0[i] = 1 for every 0 <= i < n; (2) A^k[i] = target[i] for every 0 <= i < n; and (3) for every t with 0 <= t < k there is an index i_t with 0 <= i_t < n such that A^{t+1}[i_t] = sum_{j=0}^{n-1} A^t[j] and A^{t+1}[j] = A^t[j] for every j with 0 <= j < n and j != i_t. Equivalently, r is false exactly when no such finite sequence exists.
preconditions: Let n = len(target). The slice is nonempty with 1 <= n <= 50000, and every entry satisfies 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every target satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result (a Bool); it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: Let n = len(target). The slice is nonempty with 1 <= n <= 50000, and every entry satisfies 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is true if and only if target[0] = 1.
Whenever the function returns a result r, r is true.
preconditions: n = len(target) >= 1 and target[i] = 1 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is false.
preconditions: n = len(target) > 1 and there exists an integer c > 1 such that target[i] = c for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, the greatest positive integer d that divides target[i] for every 0 <= i < n is 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(target). The slice is nonempty with 1 <= n <= 50000, and every entry satisfies 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is true if and only if gcd(target[0], target[1]) = 1, where gcd(a,b) is the greatest positive integer dividing both a and b.
Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true and target is not the all-ones array, there is exactly one index i with 0 <= i < n such that target[i] > sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j].
preconditions: Let n = len(target) > 1, with 1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: There is a unique index i with 0 <= i < n such that target[i] > sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j]. For this i, define target' by target'[i] = target[i] - sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j] and target'[j] = target[j] for every j != i. Then target' is constructible from the all-ones array by the same operation, i.e. there is a finite sequence as in spec_1 ending at target'.
preconditions: Let n = len(target) > 1, with 1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n. Assume the function returns r = true and target is not the all-ones array.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is true if and only if there exists an integer q >= 0 such that target[i] = 1 + q*(n-1).
preconditions: n = len(target) > 1, and there is exactly one index i with 0 <= i < n such that target[i] > 1, while target[j] = 1 for every j != i. Also 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, target[i] is odd for every 0 <= i < n, equivalently target[i] mod 2 = 1.
preconditions: n = len(target) is odd, with 1 <= n <= 50000, and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every permutation pi of {0,...,n-1}, let target' be defined by target'[i] = target[pi(i)] for 0 <= i < n. Whenever the function returns a result r on target and a result r' on target', we have r = r'.
preconditions: Let n = len(target). The slice is nonempty with 1 <= n <= 50000, and every entry satisfies 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, sum_{i=0}^{n-1} target[i] >= 2*n - 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(target) > 1, with 1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n. Assume target is not the all-ones array.

statement: Let i be the unique index with 0 <= i < n such that target[i] > sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j]. Then every finite sequence A^0,...,A^k as in spec_1 with A^k = target has k >= 1, and its last step (t = k-1) chooses index i, i.e. i_{k-1} = i.
preconditions: Let n = len(target) > 1, with 1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n. Assume the function returns r = true and target is not the all-ones array.

statement: Whenever the function returns results r on target and r' on target', r = true if and only if r' = true; equivalently, target is constructible exactly when target' is constructible.
preconditions: Let n = len(target) > 1, with 1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 10^9 for 0 <= i < n. Assume target is not the all-ones array and has a unique index i with 0 <= i < n such that target[i] > sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j]. Define target' by target'[i] = target[i] - sum_{0 <= j < n, j != i} target[j] and target'[j] = target[j] for every j != i.
